tool.name: notepadpp_new_document
tool.description: Create a new empty document (tab) in the running Notepad++ instance by calling Notepad_plus::fileNew() in-process. Returns open-file count and current buffer id before/after.

resolution.strategy: module-relative RVA, guarded by PE TimeDateStamp + prologue bytes
resolution.calling_convention: Win64 __thiscall: RCX = Notepad_plus*, no other args, void return

this_resolution.steps: FindWindowEx(class) owned by pid -> GetWindowLongPtr(GWLP_USERDATA) = Notepad_plus_Window* -> +core_offset = Notepad_plus*

resolution.thread_affinity: UI thread (window owner); dispatched inside DispatchMessageW, woken by PostMessage(WM_NULL)

chain: 0x14013c7a0 decompiles to: newEmptyDocument(FileManager::getInstance()); loadBufferIntoView(this, buf, this->_activeView@0x32fc, true); inlined switchToFile via _mainDocTab@0x800/_subDocTab@0x808
discovery.runtime_layout_probe: self-reference scan of Notepad_plus_Window found exactly one back-pointer at +0x20; _hSelf at +0x18 == HWND

postcondition_note: NPPM_GETNBOPENFILES(ALL_OPEN_FILES) increases by exactly 1 and NPPM_GETCURRENTBUFFERID changes

postcondition.why: TCM_GETITEMCOUNT summed over document tab bars
